name: Self-healing for regression failures and BLOCKED
description: FADE currently halts when regression tests fail or when the agent reports BLOCKED. This breaks autonomous flow. This PRD introduces a controlled self-healing loop: on common failure modes, FADE creates corrective bug work, selects an appropriate model, attempts fixes, re-runs regression, and resumes work. The goal is autonomy with guardrails—not chaos.

userStories.title: Auto-heal regression test failures
userStories.description: When regression fails, FADE should switch into a bug-fix loop rather than stopping.
acceptanceCriteria: When regression tests fail, FADE emits `regression_end` with `success=false` and captures failure summary (paths + failing assertions).
FADE generates a Bug PRD (type `bug`) into `fade/prds/` or a dedicated `fade/prds/auto/` folder with clear description and acceptance criteria.
FADE runs a 'bug-fix agent' pass to address the failure using a model chosen by the complexity estimator (ENH-023).
After a fix attempt, FADE re-runs regression tests automatically.
If tests pass, FADE returns to the original PRD/story and continues.
If tests fail after K attempts (configurable; default 2), FADE stops with a clear summary and leaves the bug PRD queued for human review.

userStories.title: Auto-triage and retry BLOCKED states
userStories.description: When the agent signals BLOCKED, FADE should attempt resolution steps before requiring human input.
acceptanceCriteria: FADE detects BLOCKED signals and records a `blocked` event with reason.
FADE categorizes BLOCKED reasons into at least: missing dependency/command, unclear requirement, failing tests, environmental issue, permission issue.
For recoverable categories (e.g., failing tests, missing command), FADE automatically attempts a resolution step (install guidance, alternative command, or bug-fix loop).
If still BLOCKED, FADE creates a short 'operator question' artifact in `fade/runs/<run_id>/operator_questions.md` that you can answer, then resume via `fade resume <run_id>`.
